meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, Senpi/pi, OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Senpi/pi/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索和回顾各类编码助手的对话记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常使用编码助手并需要快速查找之前的对话。
copy.tagline_en: Search and review coding agent session transcripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use coding agents and need to quickly find past conversations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索、列出、读取本地电脑上各种编程助手（如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等）的历史会话记录，包括对话内容、会话 ID、使用时间、模型、token 消耗等，并支持按平台、日期、工作目录等条件过滤。
howto.when: 当你询问“我昨天做了什么”、“我们之前是不是做过这个”等记忆类问题，或者要求查找、读取、导出某个编程助手的会话记录时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下昨天用 Claude Code 修复 bug 的会话。
say.note: Claude 会搜索指定平台最近一天的会话并列出匹配结果。

say.text: 列出最近一周所有 OpenCode 的会话。
say.note: Claude 会按平台和时间过滤，返回会话列表。

say.text: 读取会话 ID 为 abc123 的完整记录。
say.note: Claude 会显示该会话的详细内容，包括用户消息和子会话。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search, list, and read local coding-agent sessions (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode) including transcripts, session IDs, timestamps, models, token usage, and more, with filters by platform, date, working directory, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask memory-recall questions like 'what did I do yesterday' or 'did we already do this', or request to find, read, or export a coding-agent session.

say_en.text: Find the session where I fixed a bug with Claude Code yesterday.
say_en.note: Claude searches for sessions from the specified platform within the last day.

say_en.text: List all OpenCode sessions from the past week.
say_en.note: Claude filters by platform and time, returning a list of sessions.

say_en.text: Read the full transcript of session ID abc123.
say_en.note: Claude shows detailed content including user messages and sub-sessions.
